fusions.name: Shaggy Clinch
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in coils of hair and crushes it against you for 15 blunt damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Maul
fusions.desc: Brings down two great paws of matted hair, dealing 32 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Your hair thickens into a heavy pelt, raising your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and your frost resistance rises by 15%.

fusions.name: Felted by Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, your hair mats thicker: a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
